prompt.en: Which province is the most easterly point in North America?
prompt.fr: Quelle province constitue le point le plus à l'est de l'Amérique du Nord?

explanation.en: No part of North America reaches further east than Newfoundland and Labrador. Its heritage is closely tied to the sea.
explanation.fr: Aucune partie de l'Amérique du Nord ne s'avance plus à l'est que Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador. Son patrimoine est étroitement lié à la mer.

source.quote: Newfoundland and Labrador is the most easterly point in North America and has its own time zone.

verification.evidence: Newfoundland and Labrador is the most easterly point in North America and has its own time zone. In addition to its natural beauty, the province has a unique heritage linked to the sea.
